there are two distinct types of breast cancer that are driven by different biological mechanisms.

obesity and insulin resistance may be associated with more aggressive features in breast cancer, including larger tumour size, higher grade, higher proliferation, higher Ki67 index and more lymph node involvement.

obesity and insulin resistance may be associated with worse prognosis in breast cancer patients, particularly among postmenopausal women, and may also be associated with more aggressive tumor features.
